//: Mobile performance budget for Airen. There is no CI runner in this repo yet, so this file is the budget rather than a pipeline: run it locally with `npx @lhci/cli autorun` against a production build. When CI exists, wire the same command into it unchanged.

settings.//: Emulated mobile is the target, not desktop. The `mobile` preset throttles CPU and network, which is the only honest way to measure a phone.

assertions.//: CLS is an error rather than a warning because it is the one metric a skeleton or a late font swap can silently ruin, and it is what makes a mobile page feel broken even when it is fast.
